description: Ministry of Labour of Foreign Employment - The Industrial Disputes between N. L. D. P. H. Santharajah, Galle Road Ratmalana and Other Part Ceylon Electricity Board Colombo 02
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the repudiation and declaration regarding an arbitrator's award under the Industrial Disputes Act. It involves legal procedures, statutory notices, and regulatory compliance with specific labor legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter.
